title: project-name: the units section alone - one goal per unit, the detail first

goals.title: The reader unit: what it accepts and what it refuses
goals.notes: A unit is a goal read for its detail: what it is, what it touches, what judges it, and the decision its notes record. This row reads as the detail sheet of the reader unit.

goals.title: The writer unit: the other half of the same surface
goals.notes: Two units can be independent - no parent, no after edge - when neither owns the other. The units section answers per-unit questions; the plan section (the same goals read for their edges) answers what comes next.
